description: Nothing's actually broken that hitting won't briefly fix. Do the rounds with a wrench: bang the pipes at the Threshold, Threshold East, and the Loading Bay until the gauges twitch. That's the whole job. 15₵.
name: Percussive Maintenance

objectives.desc: Bang the pipes at the Threshold
emotes: {who} whacks a dead pipe at the Threshold and watches a gauge flicker back to a lie.
{who} gives the junction a rhythmic thumping, ear cocked for the specific clunk that means 'fine.'
{who} kicks a valve that a wrench couldn't move, and it moves. Percussion works.

objectives.desc: Bang the pipes at Threshold East
emotes: {who} raps down the run of pipe in Threshold East, chasing a hiss to its source and clobbering it.
{who} hits a manifold twice, the second time out of spite, and the pressure holds.
{who} presses an ear to cold metal, hears nothing good, and hits it anyway.

objectives.desc: Bang the pipes at the Loading Bay
emotes: {who} finishes the round at the Loading Bay, wrench ringing off the last stubborn coupling.
{who} thumps a compressor until it coughs, catches, and pretends to work for another day.
{who} steps back, listens to the whole system rattle in rough harmony, and calls it repaired.
